result.summary: The image depicts a large, industrial-scale intersection that is highly hostile to pedestrians. There is a complete lack of visible sidewalks, pedestrian signals, or protected crossings, forcing any pedestrians to navigate a wide expanse of roadway alongside heavy vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are severely degraded and barely visible, failing to clearly define a safe crossing zone for drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection across the side street

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: The absence of sidewalks forces pedestrians to walk on unpaved shoulders or directly in the path of vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground and along the roadway edges

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection creates a long exposure time for pedestrians without any refuge islands or mid-point protection.

interventions.title: Sidewalk and Curb Ramp Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps to provide a dedicated and accessible space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings and dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median refuge island to reduce crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area mid-intersection.

result.summary: The intersection is designed primarily for high-volume vehicular traffic, featuring wide lanes and long crossing distances. Pedestrian infrastructure is minimal, consisting of faded crosswalk markings and a narrow, uncurbed asphalt path, with no visible pedestrian signals or accessible ramps.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide multi-lane roadway without the protection of a median refuge island.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated signals are visible to indicate safe crossing intervals for pedestrians at this signalized intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic signal poles at the intersection

hazards.name: Inaccessible Transitions
hazards.description: The lack of curb ramps and the presence of dirt/gravel between the path and the road create barriers for mobility-impaired users.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner where the asphalt path meets the roadway

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised islands in the center of the roadway to reduce exposure time and provide a safe waiting space.

interventions.title: Add Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear guidance on crossing times.

interventions.title: Construct ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install concrete curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to ensure the crossing is accessible to all users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, featuring a wide multi-lane arterial road with no visible sidewalks or marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced to share space with high-speed traffic, and sightlines are significantly compromised by large vehicles and expansive paved areas.

hazards.name: Large vehicle obstruction
hazards.description: A large pickup truck in the foreground blocks sightlines between pedestrians and traffic.

hazards.name: Absence of sidewalks
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian walkways are visible, forcing pedestrians to walk on the roadway shoulder.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection lacks refuge islands, increasing pedestrian exposure time to vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalks to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Enhancements
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian signals at the intersection to improve safety and visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions to shorten crossing distances and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and marked crosswalks, but the wide roadway creates a significant crossing distance. The lack of a median refuge island increases exposure for pedestrians crossing multiple lanes of traffic. High-speed vehicle movements are facilitated by the broad intersection geometry.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a break, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: There is no median or island for pedestrians to wait safely if they cannot complete the crossing in one cycle.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane or shoulder to shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard parallel line markings to continental or ladder patterns for better visibility.
